credit: Romio et al. (2026), Pyroduct Digital Catalog v3.0; original La Corona survey by VIGEA, published by Tomasi et al. (2022)
method: Read the 74 ES.LNZ.00 TXT outlines in catalog order; remove three repeated curve-fitting vertices; subtract each outline minimum X and Y; calculate width, height, and shoelace polygon area in meters.
caveats: The catalog sections are digitized 2-D drawings, not the restricted raw 3-D survey.
Their drawing coordinates do not locate a section along the tube or on the Earth DEM.
No section-specific ceiling-to-surface distance, roof stability, or traversable path is known.
Reported shape dimensions are descriptive, not rover clearance or a planetary measurement.
